title: ATIF ingestion document (agr contract)
description: The concrete ATIF-shaped JSON document that agr ingests (spec §7.2). This is the target an adapter author converts a harness log into. It is intentionally minimal: only the fields the deterministic core reads are constrained here. Vocabularies are generated from code and guarded by tests/test_atif_schema.py so this file cannot drift from agr/events.py and agr/schema.py.

atif_version.description: Exact ATIF schema version of the source. Preserved verbatim on every capture; never assumed.

capture_completeness.description: How complete this capture is (spec §6.1/§7.3). Defaults to "complete" when omitted.

capabilities.description: Per-capability observability level the source actually provides. Anything omitted defaults to "unavailable" — missing observability is stated, never assumed present. Detectors that depend on an unavailable capability report "not evaluated" instead of guessing.

run.description: Run identity. logical_run_id and task_id must be supplied externally — the core will not invent them.

logical_run_id.description: Stable identity for this logical run. Re-ingesting the same bytes under this id is idempotent; different bytes create a linked capture revision.

sweep_id.description: Sweep this run belongs to (spec §4.3.1, §7.1). Names a comparison side (§4.16); supply it when runs are grouped into a sweep.

configuration_id.description: Pinned configuration identity (spec §4.16). Names a comparison side; supply it when comparing configurations.

environment_image_digest.description: Environment image digest, e.g. "sha256:..." (spec §12.3). An exact-match key for version comparison; absence is reported as an unresolved key, never treated as equal.

task_parameters.description: Structured task parameters (spec §12.3). An exact-match key for version comparison; absence is an unresolved key, not equality by omission.

steps.description: The trajectory as ordered steps. Every step_id must be unique. Each step's kind must be in the controlled vocabulary below — the event timeline maps exactly these and rejects anything else.

kind.description: Step kind. Controlled vocabulary (agr/events.py:KIND_TO_EVENT). An unknown kind is rejected at ingest.

actor.description: Who produced the step (e.g. "main_agent", "tool", "harness", "environment"). Optional; defaults to "unknown" if omitted. Free text — not a controlled vocabulary.

content.description: Human-readable text payload, copied verbatim into the derived event.

data.description: Structured payload (e.g. bytes written by a tool_call).

cost.description: Optional per-step cost accounting, carried through untouched.

task.description: Optional structured task declaration used to build the draft contract (spec §8.2). The free-text instruction is retained as a source pointer, never parsed by the deterministic core. Omit fields that aren't declared by the source rather than inventing them.

verifier.description: Optional verifier sidecar. Supplied externally — with no verifier the run ingests with no verifier evidence (spec §7.2). Every check maps to contract items and carries an explicit source.
